blocks.text: אֱלֹהֵינוּ. עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּךָ. וְעַל יְרוּשָׁלַיִם עִירֶךָ. וְעַל צִיּוֹן מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶךָ. וְעַל מַלְכוּת בֵּית דָּוִד מְשִׁיחֶךָ. וְעַל מְכוֹנְךָ וְהֵיכָלֶךָ:
uncertainties: This continues from the previous page, so the start of the sentence is not on this scan.
יְרוּשָׁלַיִם is printed plene, with yod.

blocks.text: עוֹד יִזְכָּר לָנוּ אַהֲבַת אֵיתָן, אֲדוֹנֵינוּ. וּבֵן הַנֶּעֱקָד יַשְׁבִּית מְדַיְּנֵנוּ. וּבִזְכוּת הַתָּם יוֹצִיא אָיוֹם (כ״א הַיּוֹם) לְצֶדֶק דִּינֵנוּ. כִּי קָדוֹשׁ הַיּוֹם לַאֲדֹנֵינוּ: בְּאֵין מֵלִיץ יֹשֶׁר מוּל מַגִּיד פֶּשַׁע. תַּגִּיד לְיַעֲקֹב דָּבָר חק וּמִשְׁפָּט. וְצַדְּקֵנוּ בְּמִשְׁפָּט הַמֶּלֶךְ הַמִּשְׁפָּט.
uncertainties: The source variant is printed small and unpointed. It looks like 'כ״א היום', but the first letter could be נ (נ״א). I added the pointing on הַיּוֹם; the print has none.
I can't tell whether מְדַיְּנֵנוּ has a dagesh in the yod.
יִזְכָּר: the qamats under the kaf is as printed.
מַגִּיד: the mark under the mem could be qamats rather than pataḥ.
דָּבָר: both vowels look like qamats in the print (the usual reading is דְּבַר). I left this as printed.
חק: I can't see a ḥolam in the scan.
לַאֲדֹנֵינוּ is defective (no vav), while the earlier אֲדוֹנֵינוּ is plene.
יוֹצִיא: the final alef is a large or ornamental glyph at the line end. It is the same letter, not an extra mark.
I left out any mark at the end of the line on הַמִּשְׁפָּט.

blocks.text: פותחים הארון. חזן. ע״ס א״ב כפול. קהל.
uncertainties: The rubric is in small unpointed type. 'חזן.' sits over the right-hand (first) column and 'קהל.' over the left-hand (response) column. 'ע״ס א״ב כפול' is a note on the double alphabetic acrostic.

blocks.text: הַבּוֹחֵן וּבוֹדֵק גִּנְזֵי נִסְתָּרוֹת: וְ״מַ שֶׁהוּא בּוֹחֵן כְּלָיוֹת:
uncertainties: In every following line, the response cue וְ״מַ is the printed short form of וְכֹל מַאֲמִינִים. I kept it as a cue and did not expand it. I can't confirm the pataḥ under the מ on every line.

blocks.text: הַגּוֹאֵל מִמָּוֶת וּפוֹדֶה מִשַּׁחַת: וְ״מַ שֶׁהוּא גּוֹאֵל חָזָק:
הַדָּן יְחִידִי לְבָאֵי עוֹלָם: וְ״מַ שֶׁהוּא דַּיַּן אֱמֶת:
uncertainties: There is a stray dot after לְבָאֵי, probably a scan artifact.

blocks.text: הֶהָגוּי בְּאֶהְיֶה אֲשֶׁר אֶהְיֶה: וּמַ״ שֶׁהָיָה (וְהֹוֶה) וְיִהְיֶה:

blocks.text: הַוַּדַּי שְׁמוֹ כֵּן תְּהִלָּתוֹ: וְ״מַ שֶׁהוּא וְאֵין בִּלְתּוֹ:
uncertainties: הַוַּדַּי looks like it has no alef, unlike the common הַוַּדַּאי. The dagesh in the dalet is unclear.

הַנּוֹהֵג בְּחַסְדּוֹ כָּל־דּוֹר: וְ״מַ שֶׁהוּא נוֹצֵר חֶסֶד:
הַסּוֹבֵל וּמַעְלִים עַיִן מִסּוֹרְרִים: וְ״מַ שֶׁהוּא סוֹלֵחַ סֶלָה:

blocks.text: Our Lord will yet remember on our behalf the love of the immortal (Abraham), and for the sake of the son (Isaac) who let himself be bound for the sacrifice, He will make an end of our accusers, and through the merit of the innocent (Jacob) will the Awe-inspiring One pronounce our righteous verdict for this day is holy to our Lord. When no defender confronts the accuser, Thou wilt pronounce for Jacob statute and judgment, justify us then in judgment, O King of judgment.
האוחז

In His hand He holds the attribute of judgment.
All believe that He is God of faith.
He tests and examines hidden secrets.
All believe that He tests the inwards.
He redeems from death and delivers from destruction.
All believe that He is a strong redeemer.
He judges alone those who come into the world.
All believe that He is judge of truth.
He is thought of as ‘I am that I am’.
All believe that He was, is and shall be.
Sure is His Name and likewise His fame.
All believe that He is with none beside Him.
He remembers those who remember Him in kind memory.
All believe that He remembers the covenant.
He distributes life to all the living.
All believe that He lives and endures.
He is good and acts well towards evil and good.
All believe that He is good towards all.
He knows the impulse of all creatures.
All believe that He has formed them in the womb.
He has power over all and contains them all.
All believe that He has power over all.
Almighty, He dwells in mystery, in shadow.
All believe that He alone is He.
He appoints kings and His is the kingdom.
All believe that He is King of the world.
He leads with His mercy every generation.
All believe that He retains kindness.
He is long suffering and hides His eye from the stubborn.
All believe that He grants pardon.
He is supreme and His eye rests on those who fear Him.
All believe that He answers soft prayer.
uncertainties: Each 'All believe' response line is indented in the print. They are kept as alternating lines here.
